portInfo.description: The city offers two strong but different archaeological experiences:the central museum and the palace site at Knossos outside the centre. The Venetian harbour, 25 August Street, Loggia and Morosini Fountain make a coherent outdoor route. A well-paced day connects these through real port and road transfers instead of treating the palace as another room next to the harbour.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Knossos archaeological site, 71409 Knossos, Heraklion: A major Minoan palace visit with both ancient fabric and restored interpretation. Allow about 150 minutes (editorial estimate). Separate road transfer; confirm actual entry slot/route and heat precautions.

Heraklion Archaeological Museum, 1 Xanthoudidou and Chatzidaki Streets, 71202 Heraklion: The central collection complements the palace but is a separate institution. Allow about 150 minutes (editorial estimate). Museum describes ramp/lifts/accessibility; check current tickets/hours, not an expired seasonal banner.

Koules Fortress, Koules, Old Venetian Harbour, Heraklion: A defined maritime fortification at the old harbour entrance. Allow about 75 minutes (editorial estimate). Not the modern cruise berth; confirm interior access and exposed waterfront conditions.

Morosini Fountain/Lion Square, Plateia Eleftheriou Venizelou, Heraklion: A precise central square for a relaxed city meeting point. Allow about 40 minutes (editorial estimate). Public square; nearby businesses have their own hours.

Venetian Loggia and St Titus area, 25 August Street, Heraklion: A short architectural sequence connecting harbour and centre. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Civic/church interiors are not guaranteed.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: No terminal luggage lockers are available according to the authority’s 28 August 2026 page. Its separately linked luggage service is an independent provider, not free port storage or an automatic booking.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Follow the assigned modern-port shuttle/pedestrian route; do not walk across secure working quays or mistake Koules for the cruise landing. Allow 45 minutes for berth-to-public-exit and city/museum approach, and up to 60 minutes on final return. Hellenic Heritage gives Knossos 15 minutes by car or 20 minutes by city bus FROM the city; these are not gangway-to-site times. This guide budgets 45 minutes per port/city-to-Knossos vehicle block including collection/traffic slack. Public-bus frequency and current port shuttle terms remain unverified.
